tooltip.birmingham.geiger.description: Displays details about your Radiation Exposure
tooltip.birmingham.geiger.description_sh:
Displays details about your Radiation Exposure, such as:
- Current exposure in RADS/s
- Total RAD Accumulation
§8Note: You die instantly at 1,400 RADS.
